ModMetaData.name: RimFeast
ModMetaData.author: BenFD
ModMetaData.description:
RimFeast lets you host feasts. Place a feast spot in your hall and send a messenger to another faction: tribes, outlanders, the Empire, the houses of Medieval Overhaul, anyone not at war with you. Their guests come over, sit at your tables, eat your food and drink your beer, and your colonists drop what they are doing to join them.
The guests judge what you served: the hall, the dishes, the drink, how full they leave, the toasts and the music. A good feast raises goodwill and sends their traders your way, a poor one costs goodwill. Their leader may ask for a favour, a guest may ask for a colonist's hand, and a faction that hates you may come with poison.
When someone plays an instrument, people get up and dance. Once a year you can invite every faction at once. Feast for the colony is for your own people, no guests.
There is a second invitation button: same messenger, same gifts, and once the guests are seated you pick who dies first. If half of them go down it means war with that faction, and nobody else will come for a while.
Factions invite you back too. Send a caravan with someone who can talk.
In game the texts say house, cortege and noble by default. A setting swaps them for faction, delegation and delegate.
Requires Harmony. Medieval Overhaul is optional: with it, its houses come with their own lord, standard bearer and knights.
